01 — What Is The Narrative Forgery?

What This Is, and How It Holds Itself Accountable

The narratives handed to the American public between 2016 and 2026 have, in large part, been forged — not by one hand, but by institutions with shared incentives and shared blind spots.
This book works through the key operations one at a time against the primary-source record each left behind, and the compendium explains the mechanics: how each narrative was built, and why it held.

Volume One

The Narrative Forgery

What happened. Eighteen chapters, each anchored to primary documents — IG reports, court filings, guilty pleas, sworn testimony, FOIA releases, consent decrees, indictments. Documented behavior, not inferred intent.

Volume Two

The Neural Architecture of Deception

How it worked. Eighteen documented psychological mechanisms from cognitive science, social psychology, and radicalization research — the machinery that made the events in Volume One land, and stay landed, against contradicting evidence.
